title: About
body:
Aronetiv is a visual artist whose practice centers on color, perception, and the relationships that emerge within painted space.

His paintings are built from autonomous color forms that approach, overlap, resist, contain, or remain apart. Rather than representing the visible world directly, the works create temporary pictorial realities that exist between abstraction and recognition.

The paintings develop through the act of making rather than from a predetermined composition. Each work is discovered gradually, as color, form, space, and gesture begin to define their own relationships.

Individual works often function as fragments of a larger, continuously evolving visual world.

Alongside painting, Aronetiv works with experimental music and type design, exploring rhythm, structure, variation, and perception across different forms.
